units.source_text: ”说着，送到她身边来。

en.t: So saying, they brought it over to her side.

units.source_text: 浮舟从来没有见过这样笨拙的伺候，感到情绪十分恶劣，便说：“心情不好……”委婉地拒绝了。

en.t: Ukifune had never seen such clumsy service before, and feeling terribly out of sorts, she said, "I am not feeling well..." and gently refused.

units.source_text: 岂知她们硬要劝食，实在太不识相。

en.t: But they insisted on urging her to eat, showing a complete lack of tact.

units.source_text: 正在这时候，许多身份较低的僧人从山上下来，报道：“僧都今天下山。”

en.t: Just then, many lower-ranking monks came down from the mountain and reported, "The prelate is coming down today."

units.source_text: 这里的尼僧问：“为什么忽然下山？”

en.t: The nun there asked, "Why is he suddenly coming down from the mountain?"

units.source_text: 僧人答道：“一品公主遭鬼怪作祟，宣召山上座主往宫中举行祈祷，

en.t: The monk replied, "The Princess of the First Rank has been afflicted by a spirit, so the head priest on the mountain was summoned to the palace to perform prayers,

units.source_text: 但没有僧都参加，不能奏效。

en.t: but without the prelate taking part, they have had no effect.

units.source_text: 所以昨天两次遣使来召。

en.t: That is why messengers were sent twice yesterday to summon him.

units.source_text: 左大臣家的四位少将于昨夜夜深时分上山；

en.t: The Fourth-Rank Lesser Captain from the Left Minister's household came up the mountain late last night;

units.source_text: 明石皇后也派人送信来。

en.t: Empress Akashi also sent someone with a message.

units.source_text: 因此僧都今天下山来了。”

en.t: For that reason, the prelate is coming down from the mountain today."

units.source_text: 这话说得神气活现。

en.t: He said all this with an air of great importance.

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“我不怕难为情，去拜见僧都，

en.t: Ukifune thought, "Even if it is embarrassing, I will go and see the prelate,

units.source_text: 请求他替我削发为尼吧。

en.t: and ask him to cut off my hair and make me a nun.

units.source_text: 现在家里人少，没有人拦阻我，正是绝好机会。”

en.t: There are few people in the house now, and no one will stop me; this is the perfect chance."

units.source_text: 她就起身，对老尼僧说：“我心情异常恶劣，

en.t: She rose and said to the old nun, "I feel terribly unwell,

units.source_text: 想趁僧都下山之便，请他给我落发受戒。

en.t: and I would like to take this opportunity, while the prelate is coming down from the mountain, to ask him to cut my hair and administer the vows.

units.source_text: 请您老人家代为要求。”

en.t: Please, honored lady, ask him on my behalf."

units.source_text: 老尼僧糊里糊涂地答应了。

en.t: The old nun, bewildered, agreed without really understanding.

units.source_text: 浮舟便回到自己房中。

en.t: Ukifune then returned to her own room.
